protocol_extension: MQTT 5.0 with the Mosquitto command-line client default profile
title: An idle default-profile client starts another control packet within 60 seconds
natural_language: 在 Mosquitto 命令行客户端未覆盖 Keep Alive 的固定 profile 中，值为 60 s。客户端完成一个 MQTT 控制报文后，若连接继续存活，必须在 60000 ms 内开始下一个控制报文；没有其他控制报文时应发送 PINGREQ。
standard_excerpt: in the absence of sending any other MQTT Control Packets, the Client MUST send a PINGREQ packet
time_source: Mosquitto v2.0.21 command-line client default, permitted by the configurable MQTT Keep Alive field
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 60000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.mqtt_client_outbound_window_started: The profiled client finishes transmitting one MQTT Control Packet on an active connection and commits next_msg_out for Keep Alive 60.
ap_definitions.mqtt_pingreq_started: The first byte of a PINGREQ for the correlated client connection starts transmission.
ap_definitions.mqtt_other_control_packet_started: The first byte of a non-PINGREQ MQTT Control Packet for that connection starts transmission.
ap_definitions.mqtt_network_connection_closed: The correlated connection generation transitions from connected to inactive at net__socket_close; a broker Keep Alive reason, when present, is retained as an event field.

correlation_key: Mosquitto client instance + network-connection generation + direction; the fixed profile requires effective Keep Alive=60
projection_rule: select one active connection generation with the fixed default profile, order completed and newly started outbound packets, then project the fixed AP alphabet
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after packet completion updates next_msg_out; emit a start AP when the first byte is handed to the socket, or close after the connection state changes
review_question: 确认测试使用 Mosquitto 命令行客户端默认 Keep Alive=60，且 CONNACK 未用 Server Keep Alive 覆盖该值。
limitations: 60 s 不是 MQTT 通用常数；API 调用、命令行选项或 Server Keep Alive 都可改变有效值，因此该条仅适用于明确锁定的默认 profile。negative 与命名附加反例均覆盖截止后仍缺少后继控制报文或关闭的 late/missing 情形。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed the implementation-profile scope, effective-Keep-Alive correlation, and that the existing negative trace covers the late/missing eventuality case.

protocol_extension: MQTT 5.0 broker with effective Keep Alive 60 seconds
title: The broker receives a control packet or closes by the 90-second Keep Alive deadline
natural_language: 对有效 Keep Alive=60 s 的固定连接 profile，服务器从客户端最后一个 MQTT 控制报文接收完成起，若 90000 ms 内没有收到下一个控制报文，必须关闭该网络连接。
standard_excerpt: within one and a half times the Keep Alive time period, it MUST close the Network Connection
time_parameter: 1.5 * effective Keep Alive; effective Keep Alive=60 seconds
time_source: MQTT normative 1.5 multiplier applied to the Mosquitto command-line client default Keep Alive profile
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond 90000 ms; omitted APs are false

ap_definitions.mqtt_server_inbound_window_started: Mosquitto finishes receiving a valid MQTT Control Packet for an active non-bridge client and refreshes last_msg_in with effective Keep Alive 60.
ap_definitions.mqtt_client_control_packet_received: A later valid MQTT Control Packet from that client is completely received and refreshes the same connection's Keep Alive state.
ap_definitions.mqtt_network_connection_closed: The correlated connection generation transitions from connected to inactive at net__socket_close; a broker Keep Alive reason, when present, is retained as an event field.

correlation_key: broker listener + client identity + network-connection generation + inbound direction; effective Keep Alive=60
projection_rule: derive the effective Keep Alive after CONNECT/CONNACK negotiation, select one non-bridge connection generation, then project refresh, receive, and close events
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger after last_msg_in is refreshed; emit receive after the next valid packet refresh, and emit close after do_disconnect changes the connection state
review_question: 确认 adapter 使用协商后的有效 Keep Alive，并单独核对 Mosquitto 秒级时间轮在 90000 ms 边界的实际关闭时刻。
limitations: 该固定数值依赖 Keep Alive=60 的 profile；Mosquitto 的秒级时间轮和主循环调度可能暴露边界延后，这正是该 oracle 要检测的实现行为。negative 与命名附加反例均覆盖 90000 ms 后仍未接收或关闭的 late/missing 情形。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed the 1.5 multiplier and fixed effective-60-second profile; the exact time-wheel boundary remains an explicit implementation oracle, with a late/missing negative trace.

title: A PUBLISH negatively acknowledged with reason code 0x80 or greater is never retransmitted
natural_language: 收到 Reason Code 大于等于 0x80 的 PUBACK 或 PUBREC 后，对应 PUBLISH 被视为已确认；在该消息 generation 的剩余生命周期内不得再次重传。
standard_excerpt: the corresponding PUBLISH packet is treated as acknowledged, and MUST NOT be retransmitted
time_source: MQTT retransmission termination condition after PUBACK/PUBREC Reason Code >= 0x80
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: post-acknowledgement absence is checked over every remaining position of the finite word

ap_definitions.mqtt_publish_negative_ack_received: A valid PUBACK or PUBREC with Reason Code at least 0x80 matches an active outbound PUBLISH generation by Packet Identifier and removes or completes its stored state.
ap_definitions.mqtt_same_publish_retransmitted: The sender starts another PUBLISH for that same stored message generation; a later legitimate Packet Identifier reuse for new content is not the same generation.

correlation_key: client/broker role + network-session generation + outbound direction + Packet Identifier + stored-message generation + QoS
projection_rule: match PUBACK/PUBREC to the active stored PUBLISH before projection and retain its generation identity after deletion so Packet Identifier reuse is not conflated
instrumentation_timing: emit the trigger only after reason validation and successful message-state deletion; emit retransmission at the first byte of a later send for the retained generation identity
review_question: 确认 trigger 只在 PUBACK/PUBREC 成功匹配并完成状态删除时发出，且 generation 追踪不会把新的 Packet Identifier 复用误判为重传。
limitations: 该义务无有限截止时间；有限词通过仅代表观察窗口内未重传，采集终点应覆盖 stored-message generation 的完整生命周期。
independent_audit_note: Root review confirmed negative PUBACK/PUBREC generation matching, state deletion evidence, and the weak-finite terminal-projection caveat for the unbounded safety check.

auxiliary_source_mappings.role: later PUBLISH send for retained message generation
